changeSet.author: nfnn
changeSet.sql: alter table bank_code add constraint ck_bank_code_code check (code ~ '^[0-9]{4}$')
alter table bank_code add constraint ck_bank_code_name check (length(name) between 1 and 120 and name = btrim(name) and name !~ '[[:cntrl:]]')

changeSet.author: nfnn
changeSet.sql: alter table bank_code_list_state add constraint ck_bank_code_list_state_singleton check (id = 1)
alter table bank_code_list_state add constraint ck_bank_code_list_state_source_last_modified check (source_last_modified ~ '^[ -~]{1,64}$' and btrim(source_last_modified) <> '')
alter table bank_code_list_state add constraint ck_bank_code_list_state_last_modified_after_fetch check (source_last_modified is null or fetched_at is not null)
